scenes.vo: Alvar Aalto designed this hospital around one person: a patient lying in bed.
So he shaped the rooms down to the ceilings, the basins and the door handles.
At home, his modernism turned warm, with timber everywhere.
And this brick town hall wraps around a raised grass courtyard, up a staircase of grass.
Inside, timber rafters fan out over the council.

caption:
Modernism, but make it warm. 🌲

Alvar Aalto designed a hospital around patients lying in bed — down to the ceilings, basins and door handles. Then he brought timber and grass into modernism.
